question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the given group of words.

one who is skilled and eloquent in public speaking
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **"one who is skilled and eloquent in public speaking"** refers to someone who has **proficiency and fluency** in delivering speeches to an audience. (जो सार्वजनिक भाषण देने में निपुण और कुशल हो)

 
 
• **Example: **Martin Luther King Jr. was known as a great** *orator*** due to his powerful and inspiring speeches.
 
 
 
• **"Orator"** is a person who is skilled in public speaking and can deliver speeches** eloquently. (**वक्ता)
 
 
• **Example: **The ***orator ***captivated the audience with his profound words and charismatic presence.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Orator**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lecturer** (व्याख्याता): A person who gives lectures, especially as a profession.

 
 
• **Example:** The university ***lecturer ***explained the complex topic in a simple manner.
 
 
 
• **Spokesperson** (प्रवक्ता): A person who speaks on behalf of others or an organization.
 
 
• **Example:** The company*** spokesperson*** addressed the media regarding the new product launch.
 
 
 
• **Actor** (अभिनेता): A person who performs in plays, movies, or television shows.
 
 
• **Example:** The ***actor ***received an award for his outstanding performance in the film.
